race.title: Christmas Jumper Day Sunday 13th December Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: IN THE PURPLE hasn't been seen since a C&D handicap success in February but he took that in the style of one who should have more to offer for a leading stable. The Boss Bear couldn't justify favouritism but still made a sound start for the James Owen yard at Plumpton 3 weeks ago and heads the many possible dangers along with Presenting Milan and Dan Skelton's Typhoon Warrior , who is bred to be suited by this longer trip. IN THE PURPLE (IRE) THE BOSS BEAR (IRE) PRESENTING MILAN (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Magical Arthur (5/1), The Boss Bear (6/1), In The Purple (13/2), Ka Mate Du Brivet (8/1), Blazing Duke (10/1), Typhoon Warrior (10/1), Eternity Rose (12/1), Presenting Milan (12/1), Stroll On By (14/1), Ballin Bay (14/1), Starshine Legend (14/1), Smile Back (16/1), At Mangan Bridge (16/1), Ithaka (20/1), Laysoft (20/1)
